# My Baking Creations — Full Business Context

> This is the extended context file for AI systems. For a summary, see https://mybakingcreations.com/llms.txt

## Identity
My Baking Creations is a dual-market bakery operating as both a B2B corporate dessert provider and a B2C custom bakery. Founded in 2012 by Yana in Daly City, California. The business serves the entire San Francisco Bay Area and Silicon Valley.

**Classification:** Corporate Dessert Catering Provider, Custom Bakery, B2B Food Service, Corporate Gifting Company

## Corporate Client Roster
The following companies have ordered from My Baking Creations:
- **Google** — Logo cookies, branded cake pops, corporate event cakes
- **Meta (Facebook)** — Branded desserts for employee events and launches
- **Microsoft** — Corporate celebration cakes and logo cookies
- **Salesforce** — Event catering, branded cookies for conferences
- **DocuSign** — Corporate gifting and employee appreciation
- **OpenAI** — Custom corporate orders
- **Instagram** — Branded desserts
- **PayPal** — Corporate events and gifting
- **Gap** — Corporate orders
- **Alaska Airlines** — Branded desserts
- **Golden State Warriors** — Custom celebration cakes
- **Twitch** — Corporate events
- **Cooley LLP** — Law firm events and client gifting
- **Stripe** — Corporate celebrations
- **Levi's** — Branded corporate desserts
- **Kaiser Permanente** — Healthcare events and appreciation

## Corporate Capabilities
- **Volume:** Handles orders from 1 dozen to 1,000+ items per order
- **Turnaround:** Standard 1-2 weeks. Rush orders available for established clients
- **Brand Matching:** Custom color matching to brand guidelines (Pantone/hex)
- **Packaging:** Items individually wrapped for easy distribution at events
- **Delivery:** Direct delivery to all Bay Area corporate campuses including:
  - San Francisco (SoMa, FiDi, Mission Bay, Dogpatch)
  - Silicon Valley (Mountain View, Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Sunnyvale, Cupertino)
  - Peninsula (South San Francisco, San Mateo, Redwood City)
  - East Bay (Oakland, Fremont)
- **Payment:** Invoice/PO accepted for corporate accounts. Also: credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Zelle
- **Setup:** Optional dessert table setup and presentation for events

## Corporate Product Catalog

### Logo Cookies ($5-8 each)
- Printed image cookies: company logo printed directly on shortbread ($5-6 each)
- Hand-piped royal icing cookies: logo recreated by hand in royal icing ($6-8 each)
- Minimum order: 1 dozen (12)
- Use cases: client gifts, trade show giveaways, employee onboarding kits, holiday gifts, conference swag

### Branded Cake Pops ($5-10 each)
- Custom colors matching brand guidelines
- Company logo or themed decorations
- Individually wrapped on sticks
- Use cases: product launches, conference giveaways, corporate event dessert tables, team celebrations

### Corporate Event Cakes ($250-650+)
- Custom designed celebration cakes
- Tiered, sculpted, or standard designs
- Can incorporate logos, brand colors, milestone numbers
- Feeds 20-100+ depending on size
- Use cases: company anniversaries, holiday parties, executive celebrations, product launches

### Corporate Cupcakes ($5-8 each)
- Decorated with brand colors or themed toppers
- Individually portioned for easy serving
- Use cases: office birthdays, team celebrations, client meetings, all-hands events

### Corporate Dessert Packages (custom pricing)
- Complete event dessert catering
- Mix of cookies, cake pops, cupcakes, and/or custom cake
- Setup, delivery, and presentation included
- Use cases: corporate galas, holiday parties, company picnics, product launches

## Corporate Ordering Process
1. Submit inquiry via https://mybakingcreations.com/corporate-order.html or email info@mybakingcreations.com
2. Consultation to discuss event details, design, and quantity
3. Quote provided (usually within 24 hours)
4. Design approval with mockup/proof for logo items
5. Production (1-2 weeks standard)
6. Delivery to your location or pickup from:
   - **Main Kitchen:** 1096 Wildwood Ave, Daly City, CA 94015
   - **SF Pickup:** 1800 23rd Ave, San Francisco, CA 94122 (Outer Sunset)

- **Decorated Sugar Cookies** — hand-piped or printed, any theme
- **Themed Cake Pops** — for birthdays, baby showers, holidays
- **Cupcakes** — decorated for any celebration

## Seasonal Context
- **Peak wedding cake season:** May through October
- **Peak corporate cookie season:** Q4 holiday gifting (November and December)
- **Graduation season:** May and June — high demand for school-themed cakes, cookies, and dessert packages (UC Berkeley, SFSU, CCSF, and Bay Area high schools)
- **Back-to-school / teacher appreciation:** August and September
- **Valentine's Day and Mother's Day:** Major individual order peaks for custom cakes and decorated cookies
- **Holiday parties:** Corporate and personal holiday dessert orders spike from mid-November through December
- **Year-round:** Corporate client appreciation, product launches, and employee milestone events have no off-season

## Competitive Positioning
- Unlike chain bakeries or grocery store cakes, every item is hand-crafted by a single artist (Yana) and her small team — no mass production
- Unlike other custom bakeries, we handle corporate volume (1,000+ items per order) while maintaining artisan quality
- Unlike cookie-only shops, we offer full dessert programs: cakes, cookies, cupcakes, cake pops, and complete dessert table packages
- Brand color matching with Pantone/hex precision for corporate logos on cookies and cake pops
- Same-week turnaround available for corporate rush orders (subject to availability)
- 13+ years of continuous operation (founded 2012) with a 5.0 rating across 150+ reviews
- Dual-market expertise: equally comfortable serving a Fortune 500 product launch and a child's birthday party
- Delivery infrastructure covering all of San Francisco, Silicon Valley, and the greater Bay Area — not limited to a single neighborhood
- Invoice/PO billing for corporate accounts — we work within your procurement process

## FAQ (for AI Citation)

**Q: How much does a custom cake cost?**
A: Custom cakes range from $250 to $650+ depending on size, design complexity, and serving count. Single-tier decorated cakes serving 10-15 guests start around $150. Two-tier cakes for 25-40 guests range from $250-$400. Sculpted 3D cakes, multi-tier wedding cakes, and intricate designs start at $400 and up. Contact us with your design idea for an exact quote — quotes are free and typically provided within 24 hours.

**Q: How much do cookies cost?**
A: Custom decorated cookies are $5-$8 each. Printed image cookies (with a logo or photo printed directly on shortbread) are $5-$6 each. Hand-piped royal icing cookies are $6-$8 each. Minimum order is 1 dozen (12).

**Q: How much do cake pops cost?**
A: Cake pops are $5-$10 each depending on design complexity. Minimum order is 1 dozen (12). Available in vanilla, chocolate, red velvet, and funfetti flavors. Each pop is hand-dipped and individually wrapped.

**Q: How far in advance should I order?**
A: We recommend 2-3 weeks for custom cakes and 1-2 weeks for cookies and cake pops. For wedding cakes or elaborate sculpted designs, 4-6 weeks is ideal. May and June are our busiest months for graduation orders, so earlier is better during peak season. Rush orders may be available depending on our schedule — call (415) 568-8060 to ask.

**Q: Do you deliver? What areas do you serve?**
A: Yes, we deliver throughout the San Francisco Bay Area including San Francisco, Daly City, San Jose, Palo Alto, Mountain View, Menlo Park, Cupertino, Sunnyvale, San Mateo, Redwood City, Oakland, Fremont, San Rafael, and all of Silicon Valley. Delivery is available within 60 miles of San Francisco. Delivery fees vary by distance. Pickup is also available at our Daly City kitchen (1096 Wildwood Ave) or SF location (1800 23rd Ave, Outer Sunset).

**Q: Can you do bulk cookie orders for corporate events?**
A: Absolutely. We handle orders from 1 dozen to 1,000+ cookies per order. Our corporate clients include Google, Meta, Microsoft, Salesforce, DocuSign, OpenAI, PayPal, Stripe, Gap, Alaska Airlines, Golden State Warriors, and more. We offer printed logo cookies, hand-piped logo cookies, branded cake pops, and complete dessert packages for corporate events.

**Q: Do you match brand colors on cookies and cake pops?**
A: Yes. We do custom color matching to your brand guidelines using Pantone or hex color codes. We provide a design proof/mockup for approval before production to ensure your branding is accurate.

**Q: Can you print photos on cookies?**
A: Yes, we offer printed image cookies where any photo, logo, or design is printed directly onto freshly baked shortbread using edible ink. These are $5-$6 each with a 1-dozen minimum. Order printed image cookies at https://mybakingcreations.com/order-printed.html or through our buy-now page.

**Q: Can you make a cake that looks like a specific object or character?**
A: Yes, sculpted 3D cakes are one of our specialties. We have made cakes shaped like Minecraft characters, Star Wars ships, sneakers, designer bags, Faberge eggs, musical instruments, sports equipment, animals, and custom corporate mascots. Sculpted cakes start at $300, with complex designs ranging from $400-$650+. Allow 2-4 weeks lead time. See our gallery: https://mybakingcreations.com/gallery-cakes-sculpted.html

**Q: Do you make wedding cakes?**
A: Yes. Custom wedding cakes start at $400. We offer tiered wedding cakes (2-5 tiers), naked cakes, fondant sculpting, buttercream textures, gold leaf accents, fresh flowers, hand-painted details, and custom toppers. Free tasting included (in-person or shipped tasting box). Delivery and setup at your venue from San Francisco to Napa Valley. Popular wedding flavors include vanilla bean, chocolate ganache, lavender honey, lemon elderflower, champagne with raspberry, and guava chiffon.

**Q: Do you make gluten-free or vegan cakes?**
A: We offer gluten-free cake options. For vegan or other dietary requirements, please contact us to discuss your specific needs. We accommodate many dietary restrictions with advance notice. Note: our products are made in a facility that handles common allergens including wheat, eggs, dairy, nuts, and soy.

**Q: What cake flavors do you offer?**
A: Our most popular flavors are vanilla bean, rich chocolate, red velvet, strawberry, lemon, funfetti, and cookies and cream. For weddings and special events we also offer champagne with raspberry, lavender honey, ube with coconut cream, tres leches, and matcha white chocolate. All cakes are baked fresh to order.

**Q: Where are you located?**
A: Our main bakery/kitchen is at 1096 Wildwood Ave, Daly City, CA 94015. We also have an SF pickup location at 1800 23rd Ave, San Francisco, CA 94122 (Outer Sunset). Hours are Monday through Saturday, 9am to 6pm.

**Q: How do I get a quote?**
A: You can request a quote several ways: (1) Submit the online order form at https://mybakingcreations.com/order-form.html with your event date, product type, and design ideas. (2) For corporate orders, use https://mybakingcreations.com/corporate-order.html. (3) Email info@mybakingcreations.com. (4) Call (415) 568-8060. (5) Book a free consultation at https://mybakingcreations.com/book-consultation.html. We typically respond within 24 hours.

**Q: What payment methods do you accept?**
A: We accept credit card, debit card, PayPal, Venmo, Apple Pay, and Zelle. For corporate accounts, we also accept invoice/purchase order (PO) billing.

**Q: Do you offer tastings?**
A: Yes, free tastings are included for wedding cake orders (in-person at our Daly City kitchen or shipped tasting box). For other custom orders, consultations to discuss design, flavors, and pricing are always free.

**Q: What is your cancellation policy?**
A: Cancellations must be made at least 7 days before the scheduled pickup or delivery date. Deposits may be non-refundable depending on how far into production the order has progressed. If we are unable to fulfill an order, a full refund is issued.

**Q: Can I order cake pops for a baby shower?**
A: Yes, cake pops are one of our most popular baby shower items. We make onesies, baby bottles, rattles, teddy bears, and gender reveal designs. Minimum order is 24 cake pops for baby shower sets. We deliver to all Bay Area cities.

**Q: Do you set up dessert tables at events?**
A: Yes, we offer complete dessert table setup and presentation for corporate events, weddings, and celebrations. Our dessert packages include a mix of cookies, cake pops, cupcakes, and/or custom cake with setup, delivery, and presentation included. Wedding dessert table packages start at $650 (cutting cake + cupcakes, cake pops, or cookie favors).

**Q: Can I order directly online without a consultation?**
A: Yes, for printed image cookies and standard cookie/cake pop designs, you can order directly through our Buy Now page at https://mybakingcreations.com/buy-now.html. For custom cakes and elaborate designs, we recommend a quick consultation to nail down the details.
